title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
summary: USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, as reported earlier by Reuters. In a filing on Thursday, the publisher asks for damages of more than $25
reason: Item reports a publisher's copyright lawsuit against OpenAI. It is not a model release (1-1), research artifact (2-1), industry business event like financing/M&A/partnership/product launch (3-1), government policy action (4-1), or open-source tooling (5-1). No rule covers it.
